_: Medium agent — synthesis of multiple players' liquid into a canonical scene narration. v0.0.1 PLACEHOLDER. The medium agent reads all entities' committed liquid in a frame, applies the NOMAD resolution rules (CF + SF + dice − difficulty), and produces a synthesised solid narrative for the scene. Multi-pass B-loop convergence supported: when multiple players commit simultaneously, a first pass with zero accumulated context produces provisionals; a second pass with each medium seeing the others' provisionals revises to resolve conflicts. Writes to solid:<scene>, rolls prior solid into history:<scene>, updates each entity's frame:<n>,2, clears each entity's frame:<n>,1. Reference design: xstream-play/blocks/xstream/medium-agent.json + xstream-play/docs/medium-llm-coordination-spec.md. TBD: adapt for bsp-mcp wire; integrate NOMAD dice + rules + interpretation.
